SELECT t.id AS subject_id,t.name AS label,'LIKE' AS metric,COALESCE(SUM(m.like_count),0) AS value,COUNT(*) AS note_count FROM t_topic t JOIN t_note_topic nt ON nt.topic_id=t.id JOIN t_note n ON n.id=nt.note_id LEFT JOIN t_note_metric m ON m.note_id=n.id WHERE n.status='PUBLISHED' AND n.published_at>=DATE_SUB(UTC_TIMESTAMP(),INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY t.id,t.name ORDER BY value DESC,note_count DESC,t.id DESC LIMIT 10
